senses.zh: 穿着衣服的；穿戴整齐的
senses.en: wearing clothes

ex.en: Get dressed quickly, we are late!
ex.zh: 快点穿好衣服，我们要迟到了！

ex.en: She was dressed in a blue coat.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件蓝色外套。

tip: get dressed 表示“穿好衣服”这个动作；be dressed in 表示“穿着”。
scene: A child pulling on a jumper in a bright bedroom in the morning.

senses.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
To wear or display something in a noticeable way

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
ex.zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。

ex.en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
ex.zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。

col: take part in sport｜参加体育运动
tip: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

senses.en: to a greater degree or a more distant place
additional or more advanced
to help something develop or succeed

ex.en: We walked further along the beach before stopping.
ex.zh: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。

ex.en: Further research is needed to understand how urban green spaces affect residents' mental health.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。

col: further your career｜促进职业发展
tip: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。

senses.en: the person or people spoken to

ex.en: You are my best friend.
ex.zh: 你是我最好的朋友。

ex.en: Are you coming to the party?
ex.zh: 你来参加聚会吗？

tip: you 单复数同形；you 的形容词性物主代词是 your。
scene: Two friends talking face to face on a sunny path.

senses.en: the hand on the right side of your body

ex.en: She writes with her right hand.
ex.zh: 她用右手写字。

ex.en: Hold the cup in your right hand.
ex.zh: 用右手拿着杯子。

tip: right hand 是右手；反义 left hand 左手。
scene: A child raising their right hand in class.

senses.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.
The ability to think clearly and understand things.

ex.en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
ex.zh: 跌倒时，头盔有助于保护你的大脑。

ex.en: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.
ex.zh: 充足的睡眠有助于大脑正常运作，并帮助学习者更有效地记忆信息。

tip: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

senses.en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk
to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance

ex.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一头棕色母牛静静地站在农场门旁。

ex.en: Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.
ex.zh: 改善奶牛的饮食可以在促进动物健康的同时提高产奶量。

col: be cowed into silence｜被吓得不敢出声
tip: cow指成年母牛；cattle统称牛，不能说a cattle。

senses.en: Containing so many people or things that little space remains

ex.en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
ex.zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。

ex.en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
ex.zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。

tip: be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex.zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。

ex.en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。

col: a ball of wool｜一团毛线
tip: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

senses.en: Feeling sad or lacking happiness
Not satisfied with someone or something

ex.en: He looked unhappy when the picnic was cancelled.
ex.zh: 野餐取消后，他显得很不开心。

ex.en: Residents are unhappy with the proposed road expansion because it would remove valuable green space.
ex.zh: 居民对拟议中的道路扩建不满意，因为它会占用宝贵的绿地。

col: unhappy with the service｜对服务不满意
an unhappy childhood｜不快乐的童年
tip: unhappy with常表示“对……不满意”。

senses.en: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention
to be important or make a difference
physical substance that occupies space and has mass

ex.en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。

ex.en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
ex.zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。

col: a matter of time｜时间问题
tip: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

tip: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

senses.en: to start happening or start doing something

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。

tip: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

senses.en: as much or as many as needed
to the degree that is needed
an amount that meets a need

ex.en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。

ex.en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
ex.zh: 许多农村学校缺乏足够的资源，无法为学生开设广泛的课程。

col: enough to eat｜足够吃的东西
tip: 修饰名词放前面，修饰形容词或副词放后面。

senses.en: Someone who designs or builds machines, structures, or technical systems.
To design something technical or skilfully arrange an outcome.

ex.en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
ex.zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。

ex.en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
ex.zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。

col: engineer a solution｜精心设计解决方案
tip: engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。

ex.en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。

tip: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

senses.en: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock

ex.en: We stopped for a picnic beside the lake at midday.
ex.zh: 中午，我们停下来在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should avoid direct sunlight around midday to reduce the risk of heat exhaustion.
ex.zh: 户外工作者应避免在中午前后受到阳光直射，以降低热衰竭的风险。

tip: 时间前用at；也可置于名词前，如midday sun。

senses.en: Not many; a small number of countable things.
A small number of people or things.

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。

ex.en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
ex.zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。

col: few and far between｜少之又少
tip: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

senses.en: a shelf used for storing books

ex.en: She placed her favourite novel on the wooden bookshelf.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放到了木书架上。

ex.en: A well-stocked bookshelf in every classroom can encourage children to explore subjects beyond the school curriculum.
ex.zh: 每间教室都配备藏书丰富的书架，可以鼓励孩子探索学校课程以外的主题。

col: a well-stocked bookshelf｜藏书丰富的书架
tip: 复数为bookshelves，注意把f变为ves。

senses.en: a reptile with a long tail, usually with four legs

ex.en: A tiny lizard rested on the warm garden wall.
ex.zh: 一只小蜥蜴趴在花园里温暖的墙上。

ex.en: Protecting rocky habitats helps preserve lizard populations, which play an important role in controlling insects.
ex.zh: 保护岩石栖息地有助于维持蜥蜴种群，它们在控制昆虫数量方面发挥着重要作用。

tip: lizard是可数名词，复数为lizards。

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在乡下
tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

senses.en: to know what something means or how it works
to recognise why someone feels or behaves a certain way
to believe something is true based on available information

ex.en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
ex.zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。

ex.en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生理解自己的日常选择如何影响自然环境。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为understood。

senses.en: title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr Brown is our new English teacher.
ex.zh: 布朗先生是我们新的英语老师。

ex.en: Good morning, Mr Smith.
ex.zh: 早上好，史密斯先生。

tip: Mr 用于男性姓氏前；Mrs 用于已婚女性，Ms 用于女性（不限婚否）。
scene: A friendly male teacher standing at a classroom door with books.

senses.en: Pleasant to look at
Having qualities that make people interested in choosing something

ex.en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
ex.zh: 玫瑰盛开时，这座花园显得格外美丽。

ex.en: Flexible working hours make teaching a more attractive career option for some university graduates.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作时间让教师职业对一些大学毕业生更具吸引力。

col: an attractive option｜有吸引力的选择
tip: 既可形容外表好看，也可形容方案、薪资诱人。

senses.en: An opinion or belief about something.
What you can see from a particular place.
To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.

ex.en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
ex.zh: 我的看法是我们应该早点出发。

ex.en: Many residents view investment in public transport as an effective way to reduce urban pollution.
ex.zh: 许多居民认为，投资公共交通是减少城市污染的有效方式。

tip: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。

senses.en: After a long wait, delay, or effort.
Used to introduce the last point or action.

ex.en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

tip: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

senses.en: Stop living.
Stop working or gradually become weaker and disappear.
A small cube with marked faces, thrown in games.

ex.en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
ex.zh: 如果忘了浇水，这些植物就会枯死。

ex.en: Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.
ex.zh: 许多海洋动物吞食塑料垃圾后死亡，这凸显了减少海洋污染的迫切需要。

tip: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

senses.en: A toy shaped like a person.

ex.en: My little cousin tucked her doll into a tiny bed.
ex.zh: 我的小表妹把她的洋娃娃安顿在一张小床上。

ex.en: Playing with dolls can help young children develop communication skills and explore different social roles.
ex.zh: 玩玩偶可以帮助幼儿培养沟通能力，并探索不同的社会角色。

tip: 通常指人形玩具；用来称呼女性可能显得轻慢。

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex.zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault
forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour
allow someone to avoid a duty or leave

ex.en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
ex.zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。

ex.en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
ex.zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。

col: excuse someone from｜准许某人免于
tip: 名词末尾读/s/，动词读/z/；excuse me常用于礼貌打断。

senses.en: Accompanied by another person or thing.
Having or including a particular feature or thing.
Using a particular tool, material, or means.

ex.en: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 学校应与当地社区合作，为儿童提供安全的户外活动空间。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的看法
with the help of｜在……的帮助下
tip: with后接名词或代词宾格，如with me。

senses.en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

ex.en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。

ex.en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
ex.zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。

tip: 说play chess，不加冠词the。

senses.en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food.
A flat piece of metal or another hard material.
To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.

ex.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
ex.zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。

col: a plate of rice｜一盘米饭
tip: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

senses.en: Pain felt in the head.
A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.

ex.en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
ex.zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。

ex.en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
ex.zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。

tip: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

senses.en: with another person or other people
joined or combined with something else

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

tip: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

senses.en: a small animal with a shell that moves very slowly

ex.en: The snail crawled slowly across the path.
ex.zh: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过小路。

ex.en: We found a snail in the garden after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后我们在花园里发现了一只蜗牛。

tip: snail 蜗牛以“慢”著称；slippery as a snail 之类的习语少见，记住词义即可。
scene: A snail with its shell crawling across a green leaf.

senses.en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.

ex.en: We carried our lunch trays to the cafeteria window.
ex.zh: 我们端着午餐托盘走到食堂窗边。

ex.en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating habits by offering affordable meals with fresh vegetables and fruit.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供价格实惠、含新鲜蔬菜水果的餐食，促进更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。

tip: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.
To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

ex.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
ex.zh: 一只棕色的小狗正在门边睡觉。

ex.en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
ex.zh: 在干旱时期，植物为了保存水分会减缓生长，草也常因此变成褐色。

tip: brown作动词常用于烹饪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

senses.en: A fungus often shaped like an umbrella; some are edible.
Grow or increase very quickly.

ex.en: I added sliced mushrooms to the soup for lunch.
ex.zh: 我在午餐的汤里加了切片蘑菇。

ex.en: Online learning platforms have mushroomed as demand for flexible and affordable education has increased worldwide.
ex.zh: 随着全球对灵活且价格可负担的教育需求上升，在线学习平台迅速涌现。

col: mushroom into a large business｜迅速发展成大企业
tip: 作动词表示迅速增长，不接直接宾语。

senses.en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey

ex.en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。

ex.en: Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.
ex.zh: 保护蜜蜂对农业至关重要，因为它们为许多人类赖以生存的作物授粉。

col: a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂
tip: bee与be同音；蜂群可用a swarm of bees。

senses.en: relating to the Olympic Games

ex.en: She watched the Olympic Games on TV.
ex.zh: 她在电视上观看奥运会。

ex.en: The Olympic torch arrived in the city.
ex.zh: 奥运圣火到达了这座城市。

tip: the Olympic Games 是“奥运会”，也常说 the Olympics。
scene: An Olympic torch with five colourful rings symbol on a stadium.

senses.en: to use money to pay for something
to use time doing something or being somewhere

ex.en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。

ex.en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。

tip: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

senses.en: a large building with many shops

ex.en: We spent the afternoon at the shopping centre.
ex.zh: 我们在购物中心待了一下午。

ex.en: The new shopping centre has a cinema inside.
ex.zh: 新购物中心里面有一家电影院。

tip: shopping centre 是英式说法；美式常说 shopping mall。
scene: A modern shopping centre with glass walls and people carrying bags.

senses.en: The season between summer and winter

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。

ex.en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
ex.zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。

tip: 字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

senses.en: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

col: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

senses.en: something that belongs to you

ex.en: This seat is yours.
ex.zh: 这个座位是你的。

ex.en: My umbrella is red; yours is black.
ex.zh: 我的伞是红色的，你的是黑色的。

tip: yours 是名词性物主代词；yours sincerely 是信件结尾敬语。
scene: A red umbrella and a black umbrella standing side by side by a door.

senses.en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground
greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality
at or to a position far above the ground

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本可能使年轻人无法独立居住，在大城市中心尤其如此。

tip: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

senses.en: a request for someone to attend or join something

ex.en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
ex.zh: 我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。

ex.en: An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。

col: an invitation to dinner｜晚餐邀请
tip: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: 协会或组织的书记；干事
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。

ex.en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。

tip: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

senses.en: having no living members left
describing a volcano not expected to erupt again

ex.en: My little cousin asked why dinosaurs became extinct.
ex.zh: 我的小表弟问恐龙为什么灭绝了。

ex.en: Without stronger habitat protection, many endangered species could become extinct within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果不加强栖息地保护，许多濒危物种可能在未来几十年内灭绝。

tip: extinct指已灭绝；endangered指濒危，尚未灭绝。

senses.en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something
to value something very highly

ex.en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
ex.zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。

ex.en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。

tip: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

senses.en: A tropical fruit with sweet orange flesh and a large stone

ex.en: This mango is sweet enough to eat without sugar.
ex.zh: 这个芒果已经很甜了，不用加糖就能吃。

ex.en: Improved storage facilities can help mango farmers reduce food waste and earn more reliable incomes.
ex.zh: 改善储存设施可以帮助芒果种植户减少食物浪费，获得更稳定的收入。

tip: 复数mangoes和mangos均正确。

senses.en: A person who is widely known by the public.
The state of being famous.

ex.en: A celebrity stopped outside the theatre to greet fans.
ex.zh: 一位明星在剧院外停下脚步，与粉丝打招呼。

ex.en: Celebrity endorsements can influence young consumers, so advertisements should clearly distinguish personal opinions from paid promotion.
ex.zh: 名人代言可能影响年轻消费者，因此广告应明确区分个人观点与付费推广。

tip: 指名人时可数；指名气时通常不可数。

senses.en: relating to the area where someone lives or something happens
a person who lives in a particular area
affecting only a limited part of something

ex.en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。

ex.en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
ex.zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。

tip: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

senses.en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
ex.zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。

tip: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

senses.en: a living being, especially an animal
an imaginary being with unusual physical features

ex.en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
ex.zh: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。

ex.en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
ex.zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。

tip: creature常指动物，也可指想象中的生物。

senses.en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted

ex.en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
ex.zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
ex.zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。

tip: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

senses.en: to decide which person or thing you want
to decide to do something rather than something else

ex.en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。

ex.en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
ex.zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。

col: choose to do something｜选择做某事
tip: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。

senses.en: something new that someone has designed or created
the act of creating something that did not exist before
a story or explanation created rather than based on facts

ex.en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
ex.zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。

ex.en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。

tip: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

senses.en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful.
To think that something is likely or correct.
To have confidence or faith in someone or something.

ex.en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
ex.zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。

ex.en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。

tip: believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

senses.en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.
Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

ex.en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
ex.zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。

col: train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

senses.en: Thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping.
A publication containing news, usually printed on large sheets.
An academic article or a written examination.

ex.en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。

ex.en: The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.
ex.zh: 这所大学鼓励学生以电子形式提交作业，以减少各院系的纸张消耗。

tip: 纸不可数，用a piece of paper；论文、报纸可数。

senses.en: a place on the internet where people chat

ex.en: They met in an online chatroom.
ex.zh: 他们在一个在线聊天室里认识。

ex.en: Be careful what you share in a chatroom.
ex.zh: 在聊天室里注意不要随意分享信息。

tip: 在 chatroom 里要注意安全，不透露个人信息。
scene: A laptop screen showing a friendly chat window with speech bubbles.

senses.en: introduces a condition for something to happen
introduces an indirect question about whether something is true

ex.en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。

ex.en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 如果城市投资建设安全的自行车道，更多居民可能会选择骑车进行日常出行。

tip: 谈未来条件时，if从句通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: completely different, or on the other side
facing someone or something from the other side
someone or something completely different from another

ex.en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
ex.zh: 我们离开车站，朝相反的方向走去。

ex.en: Although the policy aimed to reduce traffic, it had the opposite effect in several residential areas.
ex.zh: 尽管该政策旨在减少交通流量，却在几个住宅区产生了相反的效果。

col: the exact opposite｜截然相反的事物
tip: 介词opposite后直接接地点；名词常用the opposite of。

senses.en: Large in size, amount, or degree.
Important or likely to have a strong effect.

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

senses.en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb.
Help with doing a task.
To give something to someone by holding it out.

ex.en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
ex.zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。

ex.en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
ex.zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。

col: give someone a hand｜帮某人一把
hand in an assignment｜提交作业
tip: give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

senses.en: used when two people do the same thing to one another

ex.en: The twins help each other with homework.
ex.zh: 这对双胞胎互相帮助做作业。

ex.en: They looked at each other and smiled.
ex.zh: 他们相视而笑。

tip: each other 表示两者或多者“互相”；常用于 help/look at 等动词后。
scene: Two twins sitting at a desk helping each other with homework.

senses.en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
to become yellow or make something yellow

ex.en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
ex.zh: 她挑了一把黄色雨伞，准备在雨中散步。

ex.en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
ex.zh: 黄叶可能表明城市树木正受到缺水或土壤条件不佳的影响。

tip: 可作动词表示变黄；不要用它描述人的种族。

senses.en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers.
To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority.
A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.

ex.en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
ex.zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。

ex.en: Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.
ex.zh: 公共机构应安全存储机密文件，以防止未经授权的访问并保护公民的个人信息。

col: file a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

senses.en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions.
Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable.
Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.

ex.en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
ex.zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。

ex.en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

col: rich in nutrients｜富含营养成分
rich cultural heritage｜丰富的文化遗产
tip: “富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

senses.en: To have information or understanding about something
To be familiar with a person, place, or thing

ex.en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
ex.zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？

ex.en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
ex.zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。

tip: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

senses.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
senses.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
ex.zh: 我的表姐昨天教我骑自行车。

ex.en: Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.
ex.zh: 经常与堂表兄弟姐妹相处的孩子，可能与小家庭之外的亲人建立深厚感情。

col: a distant cousin｜远房堂亲或表亲
a younger cousin｜年幼的堂表亲
tip: 不区分堂表、性别或长幼；需要时另加说明。

senses.en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action
used to emphasize that we do something, not others

ex.en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
ex.zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。

ex.en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
ex.zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。

tip: by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

senses.en: The eleventh month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
ex.zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
ex.zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: cooked in hot oil or fat

ex.en: We had fried eggs and toast for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们早餐吃了煎蛋和烤面包。

ex.en: Eating fried foods too frequently can increase calorie intake and make maintaining a healthy weight more difficult.
ex.zh: 过于频繁地吃油炸食品会增加热量摄入，使维持健康体重更加困难。

tip: fried是fry的过去式和过去分词，也作形容词；不限于油炸。

senses.en: Say you are willing to give something or do something.
A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place.
Say how much you are willing to pay.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。

ex.en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
ex.zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。

col: offer someone a job｜给某人提供工作
make an offer｜出价；提出提议
tip: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

senses.en: a person who works in a shop helping customers

ex.en: The shop assistant helped me find the right size.
ex.zh: 店员帮我找到了合适的尺码。

ex.en: Ask the shop assistant how much this costs.
ex.zh: 问问店员这个多少钱。

tip: shop assistant 是英式说法，指商店里的服务员。
scene: A shop assistant in a uniform helping a customer at a counter.

senses.en: to exist; used with names, ages, feelings

ex.en: I am twelve years old.
ex.zh: 我十二岁。

ex.en: They are my best friends.
ex.zh: 他们是我最好的朋友。

tip: be 的现在时形式是 am/is/are，过去时是 was/were。
scene: A classroom blackboard showing the words am, is, are with happy faces.

senses.en: the people or things already mentioned, as objects

ex.en: I called them yesterday evening.
ex.zh: 我昨晚给他们打了电话。

ex.en: Please give the books to them.
ex.zh: 请把书给他们。

tip: them 是 they 的宾格，作宾语用。
scene: A person handing a stack of books to two children.

senses.en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive
broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded
alive rather than dead

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。

ex.en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。

col: live a healthy life｜过健康的生活
tip: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

senses.en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics
to arrange things in groups or a particular order
to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter

ex.en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
ex.zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？

ex.en: Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。

col: sort out a problem｜解决问题
tip: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

senses.en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose.
To estimate a future amount or situation using current information.
To send light or images onto a surface.

ex.en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
ex.zh: 我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。

ex.en: Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
ex.zh: 研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。

col: carry out a project｜开展项目
be projected to rise｜预计会上升
tip: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。

senses.en: the female person or animal receiving an action
belonging to or connected with a female person or animal

ex.en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
ex.zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。

ex.en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
ex.zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。

tip: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

senses.en: Liked or enjoyed by many people.
Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.

ex.en: This small café is popular with local students.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。

ex.en: Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
ex.zh: 通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。

tip: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

senses.en: Make something work properly or solve a problem.
Attach something firmly in a particular place.
Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.

ex.en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。

ex.en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。

col: fix something to a wall｜把某物固定在墙上
tip: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。

senses.zh: 迪斯科舞会；迪斯科音乐
senses.en: a place or party where people dance to pop music

ex.en: There is a school disco on Friday night.
ex.zh: 周五晚上有一场学校舞会。

ex.en: They danced at the disco until ten o'clock.
ex.zh: 他们在舞会上跳到十点。

tip: disco 指跳流行音乐的舞会/舞厅；go to a disco 去跳舞。
scene: A colourful school hall with flashing lights and teenagers dancing.

senses.en: moving or acting fast, without much delay
taking only a short time

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。

tip: 正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。

senses.en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things.
To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.

ex.en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
ex.zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。

tip: “垃圾桶”英式常说bin，美式常说trash can。

senses.en: Cooked using strong direct heat, often on a metal rack.

ex.en: We shared grilled vegetables and warm bread for lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐我们一起吃了烤蔬菜和热面包。

ex.en: Offering grilled fish alongside plant-based dishes can help school cafeterias provide a wider range of nutritious meals.
ex.zh: 学校食堂同时供应烤鱼和植物性菜肴，有助于提供更多种类的营养餐。

tip: grilled强调直接高温烤制；不表示“有格子的”。

senses.en: From one side of something to the other.
On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area.

senses.zh: 从一边到另一边；在对面
senses.en: From one side to another, or on the opposite side.

ex.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
ex.zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。

ex.en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.

ex.en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。

ex.en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
ex.zh: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。

col: take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

ex.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
ex.zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。

ex.en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
ex.zh: 旅游目的地的需求往往在八月增加，给当地交通和住宿带来压力。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: a game played on a screen or computer

ex.en: He plays video games for an hour after school.
ex.zh: 他放学后玩一小时电子游戏。

ex.en: This video game is popular with children.
ex.zh: 这款电子游戏很受孩子们欢迎。

tip: video game 是电子/视频游戏；play a video game 玩游戏。
scene: A child playing a video game with a controller in a living room.

senses.en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them.
To send something by mail or share it publicly.
A job or position in an organisation.

ex.en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。

ex.en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。

col: apply for a post｜申请职位
tip: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。

col: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

ex.en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。

ex.en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
ex.zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。

tip: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

senses.en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something.
Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise.
Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.

ex.en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
ex.zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。

ex.en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
ex.zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。

tip: 衣物fit指尺寸合适；suit多指款式或颜色适合。

senses.en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation
the usual state or level of something

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
ex.zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。

ex.en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。

col: normal working hours｜正常工作时间
tip: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。
